title: PRODUCT MANAGER
subtitle: At PATI Group, we are not looking for a “passive coder” who blindly waits for tasks.
body:
At PATI Group, we are not looking for a “passive coder” who blindly waits for tasks. We are hunting for a **Product Manager (AI & Internal Solutions)** — a professional with a sharp product mindset, business acumen, and the capability to weaponize AI to design, deploy, and continuously upgrade internal automation workflows and tools.

[APPLY HERE](https://paticreativeagency.sg.larksuite.com/share/base/form/shrlgvRYrNc3P4mwVPoRXDzeyQm)

[

![](/writing/product-manager/7ca220e2-4c97-4aa5-925a-63df44819538.webp)

](/writing/product-manager/7ca220e2-4c97-4aa5-925a-63df44819538.webp)

## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

You will be directly responsible for transforming raw ideas and operational pain points from various departments (Marketing, Creative, CS, Operation) into fully functional “internal tech products”, drastically optimizing costs and multiplying overall organizational efficiency by **x20**.

- **Internal R&D:** Proactively immerse yourself into departmental workflows to dissect inefficiencies, research emerging trends, and architect AI-driven automation solutions tailored to real-time business and market needs.

- **AI Prompt & Flow Architecture:** Master advanced Custom Instructions and System Prompts. Leverage the power of cutting-edge AI models (Claude, GPT, Grok, DeepSeek) combined with MCP and CLI to construct robust, repeatable, and scalable automation flows that can be effortlessly adopted by non-technical staff.

- **Data-Driven & P&L Alignment:** Partner closely with Managers to analyze operational metrics, ensuring every developed AI tool/flow directly moves the needle on revenue growth or P&L optimization.

- **Continuous Integration & Upgrades:** Operate with the philosophy of “1% better every day.” Actively gather feedback from internal users, measure tool performance metrics, and systematically refine features.

### REQUIREMENTS

- **2 - 3 years of experience** in Product Development, Product Management (PM), Business Analysis (BA), or a proven track record of building independent digital products.

- **At least 1 year of hands-on experience** deploying AI & Automation solutions to streamline workflows and process high-volume datasets.

- **System Architect Mindset:** Proficient in mapping out complex workflows. In-depth understanding of structuring AI Projects and managing AI Context/Memory effectively to command LLMs for flawless, instant execution.

- **Extreme Ownership & Growth Mindset:** Comfortable navigating ambiguity, eager to experiment, and completely resilient against failures.

- **Blunt & Well-Structured Communication:** Ability to collaborate transparently and hold sharp alignments with Departmental Leaders, translating technical logic into plain business language.

- **Environment:** Fluent and comfortable working within **MacOS/Linux** operating systems.

### PERKS & CULTURE

- **Gross Salary:** VND 15,000,000 - 20,000,000 per month (Negotiable based on execution capacity).

- **Performance-Driven Income:** PATI rejects egalitarian compensation. Your salary and bonuses are strictly tied to the complexity of your systems and the actual value you deliver — High Impact, High Reward.

- **Comprehensive Benefits:** Full statutory social insurance (BHXH), Bao Viet Premium Health Insurance, company trips, and bonuses for Holidays/New Year/Birthdays.

- **P&L-Driven Exposure:** You will not sit in an isolated lab building theoretical features. At PATI, you will work hand-in-hand with the Board of Managers to look at products through a financial lens, understanding exactly how a block of system architecture impacts the company’s bottom line.

- **Product Ownership:** Take absolute pride and ownership in seeing your products running real-time, solving actual operational bottlenecks, and liberating your teammates from manual labor.

- **Uncapped AI Ecosystem:** Fully sponsored **All-access Premium Accounts** for all the latest AI and Automation tools, eliminating any resource constraints for your R&D.

- **Culture of Radical Candor & Foster Innovation:** High-speed, high-pressure environment that deeply respects the truth, welcomes constructive friction, and demands relentless improvement.

### WORKING CONDITIONS

- **Working Hours:** Monday to Saturday morning.

- **Location:** PATI Group Office – Midtown M7 Signature (Street 15, Tan My Ward, District 7, HCMC).

- **Employment Type:** Full-time & Onsite to ensure maximum alignment, rapid iteration, and peak collaboration velocity.

- **Equipment:** Please bring your personal laptop. Upon reaching Senior level, you will be fully equipped with a company-provided Macbook alongside other executive benefits.
